prompt.main_subject: An adult woman in an oversized white graphic T-shirt brushes her teeth at a large bathroom mirror.
prompt.composition_elements: 15-second fixed 9:16 vlog frame shows subject, mirror, sink, and reflection; one delayed-reflection gag drives the suspense comedy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural bathroom daylight and ordinary domestic realism interrupted by a subtle reflection glitch.

technical_specs.motion: Brush, rinse, leave frame, reflection pauses, catches up, then subject returns.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Pseudo-documentary vlog style, hyperrealism, fixed-camera feel, natural light, and a touch of suspenseful comedy. Duration 15 seconds. An adult woman brushes her teeth in front of a large bathroom mirror. From 0-6 seconds, her reflection matches normally. From 6-11 seconds, she lowers her head to rinse and turns to leave; after her real body exits the mirror frame, the reflection pauses for two seconds in the tooth-brushing pose, gives the camera a tiny knowing eyebrow raise, then fast-forwards to catch up and disappears. From 11-15 seconds, she turns back from the doorway; the mirror is normal and empty, and she scratches her head with a confused comic expression. Freeze on her face.
prompt.negative_prompt: gore, self-harm, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, bathroom undress, disturbing facial distortion, watermark, garbled text, extra limbs, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look
